meta.title: Disclaimer — UnLitigate
meta.description: UnLitigate shares educational information about mediation. It is not legal advice.

disclaimer.heading: Educational information only
disclaimer.draftNote: Draft copy — final text coming from Anushka.

sections.heading: Not legal advice
sections.body: UnLitigate shares general, educational information about mediation and dispute resolution in India. Nothing on this site is legal advice. We are not a law firm. Reading this site, watching our content, or filling a form does not create a lawyer–client relationship.

sections.heading: No case assessment
sections.body: When you contact us, we may share plain-language information about how mediation generally works. We do not assess whether your dispute will succeed, and we do not tell you what you should do in court.

sections.heading: Pilot scope
sections.body: Any supervised student mediation mentioned on this site is a pilot limited to Bhubaneswar and Pune. We do not claim to provide mediation services in every city.

sections.heading: When to seek professional help
sections.body: If you need advice about your rights, deadlines, or filings, speak to a qualified lawyer or an appropriate legal-aid service. If there is violence, fraud, or criminal risk, seek help through the proper channels — mediation is not the right door.

meta.title: Privacy Policy — UnLitigate
meta.description: How UnLitigate handles information you share with us.

privacy.heading: How we handle what you share
privacy.draftNote: Draft copy — final text coming from Anushka.

sections.heading: What we collect
sections.body: If you open our enquiry form, Google Forms (or the form tool we use) may collect the details you choose to enter — such as name, contact details, city, and a short description of your situation. Please do not share government-issued ID or bank details.

sections.heading: How we use it
sections.body: We use what you send so a person on the team can reply with general, educational information about mediation. A supervisor may need to see a form when student mediators are involved. We do not sell your information.

sections.heading: Confidentiality — with limits
sections.body: We treat what you share with care. Absolute confidentiality cannot always be promised — for example, if a supervisor needs to review an enquiry, or if the law requires disclosure. Our aim is to keep your information within the smallest circle needed to respond helpfully.

sections.heading: Analytics
sections.body: We may use simple analytics to understand how visitors find this site (for example, which pages are opened). This helps us improve the site. Form-open clicks may also be counted so we can see how many visitors take that step.

sections.heading: Contact
sections.body: Questions about this policy can be sent to hello@unlitigate.org.
